integrity: The source generator is reconstructed exactly over \(\mathbb F_4\); all 32 codewords, 21 minimum words, 5040 coordinate permutations, and every forced local symbol map are exhausted. The group order and element-order census are exact finite computations.
scientific_limitations: Finite theorem for the unique additive \( (7,2^5,5)_4 \) code under the equivalence defined in the cited source; it does not classify automorphism groups of other additive codes. An unindexed equivalent-representative computation remains a publication-priority risk.
title: Exact equivalence automorphism group of the unique additive \( (7,2^5,5)_4 \) code
